Carolyn Wells, The Clue.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/carolyn-wells/the-clue

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Carolyn Wells, the author, died 1942 (Wikidata Q5045486, P570 = 1942-03-26).

First publication of the text used: 1909 (SE colophon: 'The Clue was published in 1909 by Carolyn Wells.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1909, before 1931. A work first published in the United States before 1931 is in the United States public domain (rights statement below).
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published there in 1909 (Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Clue, country: United States). The United States rule settles its origin, whatever the death year of any person named above.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
